candidates.old:
LDA sfx_dp,X                    \ the period steps (16 bits, the step sign-extended)
    BPL up
    CLC                             \ the step negative (its high byte &FF): a carry leaves the high byte
    ADC sfx_p_lo,X
    STA sfx_p_lo,X
    BCS sfx_pa_clc
    DEC sfx_p_hi,X                  \ no carry: the high byte less 1
    BRA sfx_pa_c0                   \ 65C02 opcode; C = 0
.up
    CLC
    ADC sfx_p_lo,X
candidates.new:
CLC                             \ both paths add with C = 0 (LDA and BPL keep C)
    LDA sfx_dp,X                    \ the period steps (16 bits, the step sign-extended)
    BPL up
    ADC sfx_p_lo,X                  \ the step negative (its high byte &FF): a carry leaves the high byte
    STA sfx_p_lo,X
    BCS sfx_pa_clc
    DEC sfx_p_hi,X                  \ no carry: the high byte less 1
    BRA sfx_pa_c0                   \ 65C02 opcode; C = 0
.up
    ADC sfx_p_lo,X
candidates.summary: The two CLCs (negative step path and .up path) merged into one CLC before LDA sfx_dp,X: every path executes exactly one CLC as before, one byte smaller, no cycle change.
candidates.equivalence: LDA abs,X and BPL do not touch C, so C=0 reaches both ADC sfx_p_lo,X exactly as the old per-path CLCs gave it. .up is entered only from BPL up (grep: no other reference to sfx_tick.up); the negative path is only the fall-through. A, X, Y, memory and every later flag are identical on both paths (CLC only sets C, overwritten-equivalently by the ADC). Cycles per path: old CLC(2) on each path, new CLC(2) once before the split: same.
candidates.relies_on: Only that nothing branches to .up or the old line-50 CLC except BPL up / fall-through (checked by grep). Code from sfx_tick.up (&A4B3) onward moves down 1 byte, including the driver's own tables (sfx_channel_bits..sfx_noise_written, &A5C7-&A5EE, indexed X 0..3: no page crossing before or after), sfx_effect_lo/hi (-1,Y with small Y, &A67D: no crossing either way) and whatever follows in bank 7. In sfx50 the only branch crossing a page is BEQ ended (&A4F5->&A53A, rare), which crosses both before and after; no hot branch in the file is at a page edge. A byte-only saving in hot code: count it only if bank 7's later code (after sfx50) has no hot page-sensitive branch or table read at the 1-byte shift - not checked here; prefer rejecting if the gate shows any slowdown.
